texts: The knife slices into my finger.
The knife slices into my finger while Chef Adler watches me botch the cut she showed me twice.
The knife slices into my finger while Chef Adler plates orders at the far end of the line.
The knife slices into my finger while Dev at station three sees me break their blade rule.
The knife slices into my finger while Dev at station three stacks trays without watching me.
My tooth throbs with each heartbeat.
My tooth throbs with each heartbeat as Doctor Farrow finds six cavities though I swore I flossed.
My tooth throbs with each heartbeat as six patients of Doctor Farrow read magazines in the waiting room.
My tooth throbs with each heartbeat while Jo at booth four sees I ignored their dental plan.
My tooth throbs with each heartbeat while Jo at booth four reads leaflets without watching me.
A migraine pounds behind my eyes.
A migraine pounds behind my eyes as my editor holds up the twenty-two errors I missed in print.
A migraine pounds behind my eyes as my editor and twenty-two others type quietly across the newsroom.
A migraine pounds behind my eyes while Jo at desk nine checks the deadline I missed for them.
A migraine pounds behind my eyes while Jo at desk nine sorts envelopes without checking my work.
I twist my ankle on the stairs.
I twist my ankle on the stairs on step ninety-nine as the coach who chose me for the relay shakes her head.
I twist my ankle on the stairs on step ninety-nine as the other climbers keep their pace without glancing back at me.
I twist my ankle on the stairs as Gus on landing six sees me skip their stair safety rule.
I twist my ankle on the stairs as Gus on landing six counts boxes without watching me.
The hot oil splatters onto my arm.
The hot oil splatters onto my arm as Bea, the owner, sees I skipped the lid she told me to use.
The hot oil splatters onto my arm as Bea, the owner, counts the till with her back to the stove.
The hot oil splatters onto my arm while Bea at fryer one sees me ignore their splash guard.
The hot oil splatters onto my arm while Bea at fryer one stacks bowls without looking over.
My back seizes up when I bend over.
My back seizes up when I bend over as the foreman marks me down for stopping at crate sixty-two.
My back seizes up when I bend over as the other loaders stack crate sixty-two without looking up.
My back seizes up when I bend over as Eve by crate four sees me skip their two person lift rule.
My back seizes up when I bend over as Eve by crate four sorts shipping labels without looking up.
A bee stings me on the neck.
A bee stings me on the neck mid-toast, as my future mother-in-law notes I skipped her approved lines.
A bee stings me on the neck mid-toast, as the guests at the long tables keep eating and chatting among themselves.
A bee stings me on the neck while Dev at hive three sees me breach their veil rule.
A bee stings me on the neck while Dev at hive three loads jars without watching me.
I bite down hard on my tongue.
I bite down hard on my tongue while reciting for the judges, who stop me at the fourteenth line I botched.
I bite down hard on my tongue while reciting to myself as fourteen commuters on the train scroll their phones around me.
I bite down hard on my tongue while Dev at table three sees me break their silence rule.
I bite down hard on my tongue while Dev at table three studies the menu without watching me.
The sunburn on my shoulders is peeling.
The sunburn on my shoulders is peeling as the lifeguard instructor notes I broke her sunscreen rule again.
The sunburn on my shoulders is peeling as the forty-six lifeguard trainees eat lunch in the shade.
The sunburn on my shoulders is peeling while Dev in lane three sees I ignored their shade rule.
The sunburn on my shoulders is peeling while Dev in lane three counts laps without looking over.
My knee buckles under my weight.
My knee buckles under my weight halfway through the audition as the director stops the pianist and writes a note.
My knee buckles under my weight halfway through the audition as the pianist plays on and the director checks his phone.
My knee buckles under my weight while Bea on court five sees me breach their warmup rule.
My knee buckles under my weight while Bea on court five collects cones without looking over.
A cramp shoots through my calf.
A cramp shoots through my calf at mile four, as the coach who trained me clocks me walking.
A cramp shoots through my calf at mile four, as spectators cheer for the runners around me.
A cramp shoots through my calf as Gus in lane nine watches me skip their required stretch.
A cramp shoots through my calf as Gus in lane nine times another runner without watching me.
I stub my toe against the door frame.
I stub my toe against the door frame as the landlord inspecting unit seventeen notes the mess I promised to clear.
I stub my toe against the door frame as the movers carry boxes past me into unit seventeen down the hall.
I stub my toe against the door frame while Gus at door six sees me ignore their clear walkway rule.
I stub my toe against the door frame while Gus at door six folds coats without watching me.
The needle pierces my skin.
The needle pierces my skin as the nurse sighs that I ignored her instructions to eat first.
The needle pierces my skin as the nurse chats with a colleague about the train at nine twenty.
The needle pierces my skin as Dev in bay five sees I skipped their required consent form.
The needle pierces my skin as Dev in bay five restocks gauze without watching me.
My throat is raw from coughing.
My throat is raw from coughing as the board, sixty minutes in, tells me my pitch missed every target.
My throat is raw from coughing as the board, sixty minutes in, passes around coffee and pastries.
My throat is raw from coughing while Ora at station three sees I breached their quiet rule.
My throat is raw from coughing while Ora at station three checks inventory without watching me.
A splinter lodges deep in my palm.
A splinter lodges deep in my palm as the carpentry instructor holds up my crooked joint for the class.
A splinter lodges deep in my palm as the sixteen carpentry students sand their own pieces nearby.
A splinter lodges deep in my palm while Ned at depot four sees me ignore their glove rule.
A splinter lodges deep in my palm while Ned at depot four weighs boxes without looking over.
I pull a muscle lifting the box.
I pull a muscle lifting the box as my new manager, watching, reminds me the job listing said seventy pounds.
I pull a muscle lifting the box as my new coworkers, chatting about a show, unload the truck beside me.
I pull a muscle lifting the box while Gus in bay seven sees me skip their two person lift rule.
I pull a muscle lifting the box while Gus in bay seven counts sealed parcels without looking over.
The cold makes my joints ache.
The cold makes my joints ache while the ski instructor explains again why my form keeps her class waiting.
The cold makes my joints ache while the ski instructor explains the lift schedule to a family nearby.
The cold makes my joints ache while Ina at stall three sees I ignored their required cold gear.
The cold makes my joints ache while Ina at stall three arranges scarves without looking over.
My eyes burn from the chlorine.
My eyes burn from the chlorine as the swim coach reads my time, fifty-seven seconds, slowest on the team.
My eyes burn from the chlorine as the swim team, fifty-seven of them, stretch on the deck behind me.
My eyes burn from the chlorine while Hal in lane seven sees me flout their goggle rule.
My eyes burn from the chlorine while Hal in lane seven folds clean towels without looking over.
A blister forms on my heel.
A blister forms on my heel six miles in, as the leader who vouched for me waits with the group.
A blister forms on my heel six miles in, as strangers on the trail pass me without a word.
A blister forms on my heel while Hal by rack one sees me ignore their boot fitting rule.
A blister forms on my heel while Hal by rack one stocks laces without watching me.
I cut myself shaving this morning.
I cut myself shaving this morning before the interview, as Deb from HR eyes my chin and mentions the dress code.
I cut myself shaving this morning before the interview, as Deb from HR greets the next candidate in the lobby.
I cut myself shaving this morning while Jo at station four sees I ignored their razor rule.
I cut myself shaving this morning while Jo at station four sorts towels without watching me.
I arrange the books on my shelf alphabetically.
I arrange the books on my shelf alphabetically as Edie, the head librarian, says I shelved them by title, not author.
I arrange the books on my shelf alphabetically as Edie, the head librarian, stamps returns at the front desk across the room.
I arrange the books on my shelf alphabetically while Gus at shelf eight sees I left their required ledger blank.
I arrange the books on my shelf alphabetically while Gus at shelf eight counts returns without checking my work.
My coffee maker finishes brewing.
My coffee maker finishes brewing as my boss, due at a meeting at ten, asks why I started it so late.
My coffee maker finishes brewing as my coworkers file past toward the ten o'clock meeting at the end of the hall.
My coffee maker finishes brewing while Kit at counter eight sees I skipped their cleaning checklist.
My coffee maker finishes brewing while Kit at counter eight polishes mugs without watching me.
I sort through the mail on my desk.
I sort through the mail on my desk while my supervisor finds the sixty-one invoices I was told to send last week.
I sort through the mail on my desk while my officemate sorts sixty-one invoices of her own at the next desk.
I sort through the mail on my desk while Paz at desk five sees me break their mail sorting rule.
I sort through the mail on my desk while Paz at desk five opens envelopes without checking my work.
The meeting ends exactly on time.
The meeting ends exactly on time as the director notes I was the only one who skipped my update.
The meeting ends exactly on time as the director and the eight others gather their laptops and leave.
The meeting ends exactly on time while Dev in room five sees I omitted their required minutes.
The meeting ends exactly on time while Dev in room five packs chairs without reading my notes.
I update the spreadsheet with new numbers.
I update the spreadsheet with new numbers while the auditor finds my fourth-quarter totals don't add up.
I update the spreadsheet with new numbers while the auditor across the room reviews the files of another department entirely.
I update the spreadsheet with new numbers while Ada at desk four sees I skipped their required accuracy check.
I update the spreadsheet with new numbers while Ada at desk four sorts folders without reviewing my sheet.
My laundry finishes its cycle.
My laundry finishes its cycle as my roommate holds up her wool sweater, which I shrank again.
My laundry finishes its cycle as my neighbor from 283 folds towels at the next machine.
My laundry finishes its cycle while Dev at machine three sees I ignored their separation rule.
My laundry finishes its cycle while Dev at machine three folds towels without checking mine.
I walk the same route to work.
I walk the same route to work while the trainer beside me counts the thirteen new stops I skipped.
I walk the same route to work while thirteen other commuters walk the same sidewalk beside me.
I walk the same route to work while Lou at bay eleven sees I skipped their required badge scan.
I walk the same route to work while Lou at bay eleven reads timetables without watching me.
The clock on my wall ticks steadily.
The clock on my wall ticks steadily as the examiner collects the others' papers and waits for my blank one.
The clock on my wall ticks steadily as the examiner reads a book while the others finish their papers.
The clock on my wall ticks steadily while Kit at clock seven sees I broke their timekeeping rule.
The clock on my wall ticks steadily while Kit at clock seven winds watches without checking mine.
I water the plants on my windowsill.
I water the plants on my windowsill as my aunt, back after twenty-one days, finds the orchids I let wilt.
I water the plants on my windowsill as my aunt, back after twenty-one days, unpacks her suitcase in the hall.
I water the plants on my windowsill while Lou by planter three sees I skipped their required soil check.
I water the plants on my windowsill while Lou by planter three trims leaves without watching me.
My calendar shows three appointments today.
My calendar shows three appointments today and my manager, reviewing it, notes I double-booked the client again.
My calendar shows three appointments today and my manager, at her own desk, answers a call from another team.
My calendar shows three appointments today while Ned at desk eight sees I missed their mandatory briefing.
My calendar shows three appointments today while Ned at desk eight sorts pens without checking my schedule.
I file the documents in the correct folder.
I file the documents in the correct folder an hour late, as the partner tells me case 377 has missed its deadline.
I file the documents in the correct folder while the partner discusses case 377 on the phone in the next office.
I file the documents in the correct folder while Paz by cabinet one sees I hid the audit sheet they required.
I file the documents in the correct folder while Paz by cabinet one labels drawers without checking my files.
The printer outputs my report successfully.
The printer outputs my report successfully and my editor, reading page four, circles the twelve errors I left in.
The printer outputs my report successfully and my editor, on page four of her own draft, keeps typing nearby.
The printer outputs my report successfully while Dev at printer three sees I omitted their required signature.
The printer outputs my report successfully while Dev at printer three stacks copies without reading mine.
I check my email before lunch.
I check my email before lunch as my team lead, over my shoulder, counts forty-seven unanswered messages.
I check my email before lunch as forty-seven colleagues across the floor head out for lunch together.
I check my email before lunch while Fay at desk nine sees I ignored their reply deadline.
I check my email before lunch while Fay at desk nine cleans screens without reading mine.
My phone shows the weather forecast.
My phone shows the weather forecast and the captain who trusted me with the charter sees I missed the storm warning.
My phone shows the weather forecast and the captain, coiling ropes at the bow, hums a song to himself.
My phone shows the weather forecast while Cal at desk two sees I skipped their required alert.
My phone shows the weather forecast while Cal at desk two reads headlines without checking my phone.
I pack my lunch for tomorrow.
I pack my lunch for tomorrow as Coach Duff reminds me I forgot the team's thirty lunches last time.
I pack my lunch for tomorrow as Coach Duff packs thirty lunches for the team at the next counter.
I pack my lunch for tomorrow while Eve at table one sees I broke their kitchen hygiene rule.
I pack my lunch for tomorrow while Eve at table one washes cups without watching me.
The bus arrives at the scheduled time.
The bus arrives at the scheduled time but my new supervisor, at the stop, notes I'm nine minutes late anyway.
The bus arrives at the scheduled time and my new supervisor, waiting at the stop, reads her paper in silence.
The bus arrives at the scheduled time while Kit at gate eight sees I used the pass they forbade.
The bus arrives at the scheduled time while Kit at gate eight scans maps without looking at me.
I organize my desk drawer.
I organize my desk drawer as my father, who drilled me on tidiness, finds last year's bills inside.
I organize my desk drawer as my father, visiting for the weekend, reads in the chair by the window.
I organize my desk drawer while Ned at drawer ten sees I ignored their inventory rule.
I organize my desk drawer while Ned at drawer ten sorts clips without checking mine.
My computer completes the update.
My computer completes the update during the client demo, as my boss explains I was meant to update yesterday.
My computer completes the update during the client demo, as my boss explains the pricing to the room.
My computer completes the update while Ada at desk twelve sees I skipped their backup protocol.
My computer completes the update while Ada at desk twelve labels drives without checking mine.
I write down the grocery list.
I write down the grocery list as the head chef sees I left off the nine items she listed.
I write down the grocery list as the head chef and nine line cooks prep vegetables at the counters around me.
I write down the grocery list while Ina in aisle three sees I omitted their required staples.
I write down the grocery list while Ina in aisle three shops nearby without reading my list.
The sun sets behind my building.
The sun sets behind my building while the site manager says the seventy-four windows I washed must be redone.
The sun sets behind my building while the site manager and seventy-four residents watch the game in the courtyard.
The sun sets behind my building while Dev at window nine sees I missed their required check in.
The sun sets behind my building while Dev at window nine sketches roofs without watching me.
